nodes.bdb: to release, let drop or loose or rest or fall
nodes.klein: to let drop; to draw away; to slip off. he let drop, let fall; let loose, loosened, detached; he let (a field) fallow; he slipped, stumbled. he slipped off, detached, dismounted. was thrown down, was overthrown, was dropped; slipped away, slipped off, was detached, was dislocated; the laws of the ‘shemittah’ year applied to it; was missed, was omitted, was left out, was elided, slipped from. he imposed the laws of ‘shemittah’ on; he pulled out (plants); he let go, released from a debt; he caused cessation of field labor. he slided off, fell off; was dislocated; he shirked, evaded, escaped, got out by a subterfuge (cp. JAram. אִשֽׁטֽמֵיט, which has the same meanings). he caused to let drop (in the Bible used only Deut. 15:13, in the phrase הִשֽׁמִיט יָדוֹ, ‘he caused his hand to let drop’); he omitted, left out; he removed. it was left out, was omitted.
